description: React functional component for cache settings UI, managing Redis cache configuration, including loading, testing connection, and saving settings with categorized form fields and UI controls.

classes.name: CacheSettingsProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining props for CacheSettings component, including accessToken, userRole, userID.

methods.name: loadCacheSettings
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch cache settings from API and update component state.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Function to test cache connection using current form values, providing user notifications.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Function to save cache settings to API and reload current settings, with user notifications.
